mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (chat_room_id, send_user_id, message, send_date) VALUES (#{chatRoomId}, #{sendUserId}, #{message}, NOW());
mapper.select: SELECT ch.chat_room_id, ch.send_user_id, ch.message, ch.send_date, u.nickname AS senderNickname, u.profile_url AS senderProfileUrl FROM chat_history AS ch JOIN user AS u ON ch.send_user_id = u.user_id WHERE ch.chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId} ORDER BY ch.send_date ASC;
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_room SET last_at = NOW() WHERE chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId};
